He is known for his versatility on the pitch and has played for various clubs throughout his career. Alves began his professional career in Portugal and has played in different leagues, showcasing his abilities both in domestic competitions and potentially in international matches.

Throughout his career, he has been recognized for his defensive skills, tactical awareness, and physical presence on the field. Alves has also represented youth national teams, indicating his early promise and talent in the sport.
